_doc: How a wand, tome, staff, sceptre or off-hand focus ATTACKS in Oathwild (owner 2026-11-24: 'Did you keep the itemization from Thousandvale? Especially wands and tomes having special attacks or other effects'). The styles themselves are Thousandvale's (thousandvale/data/rules/caster-forms.json, read by path through js/rules/farhold.js and pinned by the drift guard): a wand rolls one of 13 styles by its id (weighted `w`), a tome one of 4 tome styles, a staff one of Thousandvale's two staff styles (22%) or else Farhold's element spell, an off-hand focus adds a rider. THIS file holds only what Oathwild adds or decides on top: the numbers for rules Thousandvale keeps in code (chain, homing, the staff's ground spell), the sceptre's swing, which style a starting kit gets, how an orb rolls its rider, a tome held in the off hand, named items, and how each style is drawn (`look`). js/rules/casters.js is the one reader; it writes every card sentence from the same plan js/rules/caster-attack.js fights with. Guessed values are marked in `_guessed`.
_guessed: sceptre.mult, homing, staffGround, starter, focusRoll, offhandTome, named items and their drop chances (Claude 2026-11-24; owner may overrule in one line).

look._doc: How the client draws each style (js/client/render/caster-fx.js): `as` = missile | cone | beam | nova | lob | melee; `scale` sizes the Spell Kit visual; `visual` names a data/spell-visuals.json visual (else the fallback for '<kind>:<element>'); every style is coloured by the item's element (the kit's school).

noPlainBolts._doc: Owner 2026-11-26: "Wands should not all be projectile, see Thousandvale. I want those wands, some shoot multiple projectiles, some cone of fire, etc. Basic projectile wands are still lame, make them all interesting or else they aren't worth using." A wand or tome that rolls one of these plain single-bullet styles gets one of `into` instead (picked by the item's id, so the same item always gets the same one; saved items change once when their hero joins). js/rules/casters.js finishCaster is the reader.
